cond_0001.intro: The primary responsibilities of this position are to assist with study level statistical related activities, particularly to write statistical analysis plans, prepare mock tables/figures/listings, and generate statistical analyses for clinical studies.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Assist with sample size and power calculation
Assist with randomization schedule generation
Review case report forms to ensure appropriate data collection
Review edit checks algorithm to ensure data quality for statistical analyses
Participate in study team operations and timeline discussion
Prepare statistical analysis plans
Prepare mock tables, figures, and listings
Conduct inferential statistical analyses and check model adequacy of statistical analyses
Perform statistical validation/quality control on analyses generated by statistical analysts/programmers
Write statistical reports for results interpretation if needed
Work with medical writers to assist with clinical study reports preparation
Work with project managers to ensure timely and high quality delivery of analysis packages
This job description does not state or imply that the above are the only duties and responsibilities assigned to this position. Employees holding this position will be required to perform any other job-related duties as requested by Management.
cond_0001.requirements:

Master's degree in statistics or biostatistics
Master's degree with 0-2 years of relevant experience in statistical analyses
Good understanding in statistical concepts and methods
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of SAS and/or R
Good interpersonal and communication skills

cond_0090.intro: We are looking for a Statistician I to join our team. The primary focus of this role is to support study-level statistical activities, including writing statistical analysis plans, preparing mock tables/figures/listings, and working with the team to generate statistical analyses for clinical studies.
cond_0090.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Support sample size and power calculation
Assist with randomization schedule generation
Review case report forms together with the study team to ensure appropriate data collection
Review edit checks algorithm to help ensure data quality for statistical analyses
Participate in study team operations and timeline discussions
Prepare statistical analysis plans
Prepare mock tables, figures, and listings
Conduct inferential statistical analyses and work with the team to check model adequacy
Coordinate with statistical analysts/programmers to perform validation and quality control on analyses
Write statistical reports for results interpretation if needed
Work with medical writers to support clinical study reports preparation
Work with project managers to help ensure timely and high quality delivery of analysis packages
This job description does not state or imply that the above are the only duties and responsibilities assigned to this position. Employees holding this position will be required to perform any other job-related duties as requested by Management.

Education
Master's degree in statistics or biostatistics
Experience
Master's degree with 0-2 years of relevant experience in statistical analyses
Skills
Good understanding in statistical concepts and methods
Working knowledge of SAS and/or R
Good interpersonal and communication skills

Work with the study team on sample size and power calculations
Coordinate with the team on randomization schedule generation
Review case report forms together with data staff to ensure appropriate data collection
Review edit checks algorithm to help ensure data quality for statistical analyses
Participate in study team operations and timeline discussions
Prepare statistical analysis plans in coordination with study leads
Prepare mock tables, figures, and listings
Conduct inferential statistical analyses and check model adequacy, sharing findings with the team
Support statistical validation and quality control on analyses generated by statistical analysts and programmers
Write statistical reports for results interpretation if needed
Work with medical writers to assist with clinical study reports preparation
Work with project managers to help ensure timely and high quality delivery of analysis packages

0–2 Years of relevant experience in statistical analyses

Good interpersonal and communication skills

cond_0366.intro: The primary responsibilities of this position are to assist with study level statistical related activities, particularly to write statistical analysis plans, prepare mock tables/figures/listings, and generate statistical analyses for clinical studies. A regular part of the role involves staying in contact with study teams, medical writers, and project managers to keep work on track.
cond_0366.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Assist with sample size and power calculation
Assist with randomization schedule generation
Review case report forms to ensure appropriate data collection
Review edit checks algorithm to ensure data quality for statistical analyses
Actively participate in study team operations and timeline discussions, contributing to decisions and raising issues early
Prepare statistical analysis plans
Prepare mock tables, figures, and listings
Conduct inferential statistical analyses and check model adequacy of statistical analyses
Perform statistical validation/quality control on analyses generated by statistical analysts/programmers
Write statistical reports for results interpretation if needed
Work closely with medical writers on a regular basis to assist with clinical study reports preparation
Connect with project managers regularly to ensure timely and high quality delivery of analysis packages
This job description does not state or imply that the above are the only duties and responsibilities assigned to this position. Employees holding this position will be required to perform any other job-related duties as requested by Management.

Master's degree in statistics or biostatistics
0-2 Years of relevant experience in statistical analyses
Good understanding of statistical concepts and methods
Working knowledge of SAS and/or R
Preferred Requirements
Good interpersonal and communication skills, including comfort explaining analyses and clarifying requirements when working with cross-functional teams
